prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / composition refinement. Repaint image 1 as ONE SQUARE full-bleed medieval fantasy item illustration, no card frame, borders, panels or badge. Preserve this exact fierce fire elemental concept, warm colors, violet smoky backdrop, two glowing eyes and mouth, flame arms and single overhead fireball, three-legged stone/cast-iron brazier. COMPOSITION CHANGE REQUIRED: fit the COMPLETE elemental, the COMPLETE fireball and ALL THREE separated brazier legs comfortably into the UPPER CENTRAL 75 PERCENT of the square (x15%..85%, y12%..76%). The bottom 24 percent must contain ONLY empty dark violet ground and soft orange reflection; no feet or important objects there, because a circular UI badge will cover bottom-center after compositing. Give the fireball room above; do not cut off its silhouette. Simplify to chunky big smooth forms with a strong rim light and fewer tiny texture marks. No inscriptions, emblems, runes, words, letters, numbers, symbols, watermark, skull decoration or new objects. This is a medieval-based fantasy world with familiar fantasy adaptations and medieval materials, not modern technology. Keep the spirit majestic and menacing, not cute.
